recordHint: Press a new shortcut · esc to cancel
permissionSub: Turn on Jupjup in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording, then reopen it.
busy: Your Mac is busy. This may take a moment.
aboutBody:
Korean for picking something up off the floor — one piece at a time.

Jupjup picks up text you can see but can't select, and leaves it on your clipboard.

Jupjup 1.0 · Font: Cormorant Garamond, Noto Serif KR (OFL)
ocrAutoSub: Your languages first, then other scripts if needed
fallbackSub: If these can't read it, try the rest
modeFastNote: Fast uses Live Text. Tables and language choice need Accurate.
obIntro: One shortcut picks text off your screen and puts it on the clipboard. Two things to set up and you're ready.
obShortcutOK: Press this any time to capture text. You can change it.
obShortcutTaken: {s} is used by another app, possibly TextSniper. Pick a different combo.
obPermissionOff: Jupjup needs to see the screen to read text. It never saves or sends what it sees.
obPermissionOn: Enabled. Jupjup can read text on screen.
conflict: Shortcut is used by another app
conflictSub: Pick a different combo in the menu
